preconditions.description: The target value k is an integer between 0 and 10000 inclusive.
The number of required tickets m is an integer between 1 and 300000 inclusive.
The input contains exactly two integers separated by whitespace.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m lines.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.strip()) == 8 and all(c in '0123456789' for c in line.strip()) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line consists of exactly 8 digits.
All m output tickets are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(any(eval_expr(digits, k) for digits in line.strip()) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: For every output ticket, there exists a valid arithmetic expression formed by inserting '+', '-', '*' and brackets between its digits that evaluates to k.
